notes: Fixed source-weak indices1/3 from earlier sourceV calibration; no new target-based class selection. All3 original BASE fixed prior references reused, no duplication of training/testing.

One clean eval forward per source L batch, no augmentation or RDrop sampling. CE label smoothing.01, original shallow/middle SupCon, exact new conditional mean/tail formulas from committed loss.py, and raw joint160 crossRX SupCon for weak1/3 are differentiated on the same graph. This is not a replay of the actual stochastic RDrop+U optimizer step.

Feature scope is all id_backbone parameters except existing cls_head, incl response and actual3SIG_TIME projections. Domain auxiliary network is outside deployed identity path. Inactive feature parameters/zero norms are reported, not hidden. W read only; no fitted classifier.

CE class gradients sum/1050 perTX over all6300; contrastive perbatch losses weighted batchN/6300, jointweak peranchor sum/1050. Fixed diagnostic permutation2026102007 shared across modelseeds. No contrastive pairs across minibatch boundaries; defined finite minibatch objective.

CLIP_PHYSICAL derivative is gq/25000; NORMALIZED_HZ derivative w.r.t p/Fs is gq*(25000000/25000). Other coordinates unchanged. Metrics are coordinate dependent and both reported; no physical double scaling or updates occur.

Full-pool cosine of summed gradients differs from mean minibatch cosine. Report both with zero-norm/undefined pairs. Dot/cosine signs do not prove actual AdamW descent, causality, unseenRX generalization, or target improvement.
Raw gradient vectors and IQ are not saved to Git; runtime emits only aggregated norms/Gram/cosines, block names and finite-batch summaries. No checkpoint is written or updated.
